mapper.update: INSERT INTO workplace_info (merge_key, base_info, women_activity_info, compatibility_of_childcare_and_work) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{baseInfoId}, #{womenActivityInfoId}, #{compatibilityId}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO NOTHING
UPDATE company SET workplace_info = #{mergeKey}, updated_at = now() WHERE corporate_number = #{corporateNumber}
UPDATE company SET workplace_info = null, updated_at = now() WHERE corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} AND workplace_info IS NOT NULL
